notes: Design fidelity holds. Surfaces are near-black, there is one green accent, buttons are uppercase pills, type is compact, and typecheck and lint pass. Commit 4c5634b fixes most of the high-impact findings, and the fresh screenshots confirm the visible ones. Fixed: countdowns wait for the chain clock, so phone-booked-dashboard.png reads 'sales close in …' instead of '20735d'. The phone grid has no empty band under the nav (phone-feed.png, phone-approvals.png). Chain feed lines keep tickets and SOL for agent tours, and ShowSettled says 'band' rather than 'you'. fetchLiveTour sets salesOpenAt for app tours, so 'behind pace' can fire. /feed and the dashboard fall back to each show's current state instead of 'nothing else has happened' (7-booked-dashboard.png shows three useful lines). A re-plan with other venues becomes its own tour, and the band is told on the booked screen. Book cannot be pressed twice. The show page drops the bare 'Ticket purchases (0)' header, shows holdings in euros and says 'One wallet holds one ticket purchase per show'. Partly fixed: the restart path now tells the band, but the abandoned tour's shows stay invisible to the dashboard and show page, and show.all still runs twice. The holding line reads '1 ticket (€400)' beside 'Ticket €20'. The wizard's '€20 (that is 0.0002 SOL…)' still conflicts with the dashboard counting one 0.0002 SOL ticket as 20 fans and €400. The changes also bring new problems. On the show page the clock is now set only after fetchTicketsForShow (getProgramAccounts) succeeds. When public devnet refuses that call, the countdowns stay '…' for good, the crank button never appears (now stays 0), and a fan who already holds a ticket is not shown it and sees Buy again. 8-own-show.png says 'No purchases read yet. They appear here as fans buy.' beside 'Fans 80 / 400' and €1,600 held. The fallback disappears as soon as the first 8 signatures (all from the first show) are decoded. For a few minutes the feed then shows only Berlin's sales, and the other shows' states are gone. Fallback rows carry the current time, so every line reads 'now'. TicketBought reads '20 fans more sold'. Still open: health wording ('120 fans more and it goes ahead'); show-page state is not reset on address change; only the latest tour is searched; the show page has no demo-clock note; the crank sits only in the fan's card; the partial marker is never checked against chain; inApp depends on a free-text region; the slot order is unused; the doc comments are stacked; the font is not shipped; phone-venues.png is 10,508 px tall; on phones the compact feed hides every line's text and leaves only group counts; there is still no screenshot of the fan buy or refund flow.
issues: packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:53-63: setNow(chainTime()) and setMine run only after fetchTicketsForShow (getProgramAccounts) succeeds. If public devnet refuses it, now stays 0 forever (the tick no longer counts from 0), so 'Sales close in' and 'Show in' read '…', the 'check the result now' crank (line 261, now >= deadline) never appears, and a wallet that holds a ticket gets the Buy button again. Fix: fetch the clock and fetchTicket independently (Promise.allSettled) and catch the ticket list on its own

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:282-285: when the ticket list is empty but acct.ticketsSold > 0, the page says 'No purchases read yet. They appear here as fans buy.' beside 'Fans 80 / 400' and €1,600 held (8-own-show.png). Fix: when ticketsSold > 0, say '{fans} fans have bought; the purchase list could not be read from devnet right now'

packages/web/src/lib/chain-live.ts:233 with components/Feed.tsx:134: the fallback ends once any event decodes, but fetchShowEvents decodes only 8 signatures per poll, all from the first show (Map insertion order). For several polls the feed then shows only that show's sales, and the other shows' states disappear. Fix: decode round-robin across shows (newest per show first) and keep the showsFeed line for any show that has no decoded events yet

packages/web/src/lib/book.ts:173-185: the restart now tells the band, but the abandoned tour's signed shows stay invisible. fetchLiveTour (chain-live.ts:70) reads only toursCreated-1, so the dashboard, /feed and show pages drop them while fans can still buy. show.all also still runs twice on resume. Fix: list the abandoned shows with links on the booked screen (or look up earlier tours), and reuse the first show.all result

packages/web/src/components/Feed.tsx:29: showsFeed stamps every fallback line with Date.now(), and the dashboard rebuilds it every second, so 'Played and paid out' and 'Booked' all read the current time (7-booked-dashboard.png: 08:16 on every row). Fix: use the show's date or deadline as at, or hide the time on fallback rows

packages/web/src/lib/health.ts:63,75-76: '120 fans more and it goes ahead' / 'Behind pace: 120 fans more needed' (7-booked-dashboard.png), and in recordings 'Goes ahead with 12; still selling'. Fix: `${fans(need)} more fans` and 'Goes ahead with 12 sold'
packages/web/src/lib/chain-live.ts:130: TicketBought reads '20 fans more sold (40 fans so far)'. Fix: units-aware text such as '20 more fans bought (40 so far)' / '1 more ticket sold (2 so far)'

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:270: 'one ticket per 20 people, at €20 (that is 0.0002 SOL of devnet play money)' still says one on-chain ticket costs €20, while the dashboard counts the same 0.0002 SOL ticket as 20 fans and €400. Fix: 'each on-chain ticket stands for 20 fans and costs 0.0002 SOL of play money (€20 per fan)'
packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:240: in live mode the line reads 'You hold 1 ticket (€400)' under a 'Ticket €20' stat. Fix: 'You hold 1 ticket = 20 fans (€400)'

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:28-32,82-99: run, others, venueName and live are never reset when address changes, and live is only ever set to true, so client-side navigation from an app show to an agent show keeps fans and euros. Fix: reset these at the start of the effect and call setLive(!!(me && live?.inApp))
packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:87-90: only the band's latest tour is searched, so shows from earlier or abandoned tours get the h1 'Show' and SOL units. Fix: fetch the tour named in acct.tour

packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:181-188: 'Sales close in 29m 50s' and 'Show in 59m 50s' sit beside 'Day 1 · Nov 3' with no demo-clock and 1-ticket-=-20-fans note (8-own-show.png). Fix: reuse the dashboard's one-line note when live
packages/web/src/app/show/page.tsx:261-268: the crank is still only in the fan's card, so a band cannot settle its own show when the keeper is late. Fix: render it below both cards

packages/web/src/app/globals.css:1158-1161: on phones .g-latest is hidden and the compact feed shows only 'Bookings 1 / Ticket sales 1' with no text (phone-feed.png), so the live feed says nothing until a group is opened. Fix: keep g-latest on phones, moved to a second line of the summary

packages/web/src/lib/chain-live.ts:93: salesOpenAt = deadline - SALES_SEC assumes sales open at booking. Venues sign when the */10 cron keeper runs, and GitHub often delays that, so a show can read 'at risk' as soon as it goes on sale. Fix: use the ShowAccepted block time when known, or start the pace window at max(booking, first keeper tick)

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:36-47: the saved partial-booking marker is still never checked against chain, so a marker from a booking that finished elsewhere keeps offering 'Finish booking'. Fix: verify toursCreated-1 === saved.tourId on load and clear it when stale

packages/web/src/app/tour/new/page.tsx:96: the dynamic import of @/lib/book sits outside try/finally. If the chunk fails to load (offline, a stale deploy), busy stays set and the Book button stays disabled for good. Fix: move the import inside the try
packages/web/src/lib/chain-live.ts:98-100: inApp still relies on the free-text region 'Greenroom app'. Fix: also check the price scale (ticketPriceLamports <= 200*LAMPORTS_PER_EURO)

packages/web/src/lib/chain-live.ts:158-160,215,229,248: a null getParsedTransaction (not yet indexed) is cached in seen as [] and never refetched, and the per-signature slot order is computed but unused, so same-second events sort by decode id. Fix: skip caching null results and sort by (blockTime, slot)
packages/web/src/app/venues/page.tsx: phone-venues.png is still 10,508 px tall. Fix: collapse the city cards on phones or default to one country
packages/web/src/lib/format.ts:40-41: two stacked doc comments on dayLabel; the first belongs to demoDate

packages/web/src/app/globals.css:22: SpotifyMixUI and CircularSp are not shipped, so every page falls back to Helvetica or Arial. Fix: load a close open font (e.g. Figtree via next/font) as the first fallback

qa/src/ui-bot.ts: there is still no screenshot of a fan buying or refunding on /show, and no fixture with TicketBought or ShowConfirmed logs, so the wallet flows and the decoded live feed are never seen. Fix: shoot /show as a connected non-band wallet before and after a buy, and once for a cancelled show with 'Claim refund'
